issues.message: Noncanonical compact authoring: Authoring SVG contains noncanonical or redundant inherited style declarations (6 change(s)); examples (group:attr None -> value hoists the shared value onto that group; child:attr value -> None drops the copy the child now inherits): footer:fill None -> '#64748B'; footer:font-size None -> '13'; text[55]:fill '#64748B' -> None (advisory; normalize with `python3 scripts/compact_svg_styles.py <svg_output> --inplace`, re-stamp pages that carry Chart/Table fallbacks, and rerun the final gate, or leave the explicit form)

Reference SVG: detected 6 visible root-level <g> module(s) without explicit data-pptx-bounds (<g id="cover-background">; <g id="hero-badge">; <g id="hero-title">; +3 more); every final-page/template root <g> other than a compact authored-preset atom declares its root-coordinate layout subcanvas even when it also carries native coordinates
